style_en: Japanese TV anime style, clean bold line art, cel shading, muted colors, bright even light, Kofun-period ancient Japan. Pure white background.
avoid_en: text, letters, logo, modern clothes or buildings, Chinese-style robes, nudity, exposed skin, low neckline, blood

amaterasu.desc_en: Amaterasu, the sun goddess, a serene young woman with very long straight black hair and a thin golden circlet, white and gold Kofun-period robe with a long white mo skirt, a magatama bead necklace, a soft golden glow around her

uzume.desc_en: Ame-no-Uzume, a bold cheerful goddess of ancient Japan in her early 20s with round cheeks and bright confident eyes, long black hair tied up with a crown of green masaki vines, a sash of green hikage moss vines crossed over the shoulders as a tasuki, a fully covering white Kofun-period kinu tunic with long sleeves and a long deep red mo skirt, a small bundle of bamboo grass leaves in one hand, barefoot

tajikarao.desc_en: Ame-no-Tajikarao, a huge strong male god of ancient Japan about 35 years old, broad shoulders and thick arms, black hair in large mizura loops, a short black beard, a brown Kofun-period kinu tunic with rolled-up sleeves and white hakama trousers tied below the knees, a thick rope belt, barefoot

omoikane.desc_en: Omoikane, a wise elderly male god of ancient Japan about 60 years old, long grey hair in neat mizura loops, a long thin grey beard, calm thoughtful narrow eyes, a dark green Kofun-period kinu tunic with a white sash and white hakama trousers, a string of white magatama beads
